items.name: blue-cta-button
items.title: Blue CTA Button
items.description: The dimensional call-to-action used by SessionWatcher, with configurable color tones and macOS or Windows platform modes.
items.author: STARCK

.starck-blue-cta.background: radial-gradient(54% 155% at 50% -6%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.34) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13) 34%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 60%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 84%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--starck-blue-cta-start) 0%, var(--starck-blue-cta-middle) 55%, var(--starck-blue-cta-end) 100%)
.starck-blue-cta.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), inset 0 3px 5px -1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22), inset 0 -1px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 20, 60, 0.28), 0 6px 16px -8px rgb(var(--starck-blue-cta-glow) / 0.4)
.starck-blue-cta.transition: box-shadow 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1), transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1), filter 0.22s ease

.starck-blue-cta:hover.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.66), inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13), inset 0 -2px 3px rgb(var(--starck-blue-cta-dark) / 0.28), 0 2px 3px rgba(0, 20, 70, 0.26), 0 12px 28px -6px rgb(var(--starck-blue-cta-glow) / 0.78), 0 0 0 1.5px rgb(var(--starck-blue-cta-glow) / 0.08)

.starck-blue-cta:active.box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgb(var(--starck-blue-cta-dark) / 0.45), inset 0 1px 1px rgb(var(--starck-blue-cta-dark) / 0.4), inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 20, 70, 0.3), 0 2px 8px -4px rgb(var(--starck-blue-cta-glow) / 0.4)
